title: Extract K Smallest via Min-Heap
statement:
Given an array of N integers and a value K, build a min-heap from all elements and then extract the K smallest elements one by one.

Print the K extracted values in the order they are removed (smallest first).
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: K space-separated integers in ascending order (the K smallest elements).

examples.explanation: All elements extracted in sorted order.

starterCode.python:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here
# Hint: heapify then heappop k times
